title: DOES TERRORISM TRIGGER ONLINE HATE SPEECH? ON THE ASSOCIATION OF EVENTS AND TIME SERIES
reasoning: The paper analyzes the relationship between terrorist attacks and bursts of religious-based hate speech and counter-speech on Twitter. Specifically, it tracks hashtags like #stopislam (anti-Muslim) and #notinmyname (Muslim counter-hate speech), as well as the Arabic religious keyword 'kafir'. It investigates the ethical and social dynamics of online discourse surrounding a specific faith community (Islam).
